A.purpose: 録音2(同一wav)で5条件x3回。決定論性の実測と重み反映証拠。

audio.canonical_text: He remembered the hands held out for the chains. His friend trusted him without asking for another promise. Water came slowly through a crack in the rock. Melos drank, got onto his knees, and stood up. He managed one step, then took another. At the city gates, the bell rang for his friend's death. He raced to the square, where the sword was already raised above his friend.

sentences_positive.text: The man waiting at the gate was Melos.

The road to the city was long and the sun was already low when Melos reached the river. The bridge had been washed away, and the water ran brown and fast between the stones. He stood on the bank for a moment, thinking of his friend and of the promise he had made. Then Melos took a breath, stepped into the cold current, and began to swim toward the far side.
